case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's beachfront location, ocean views, renovated/clean rooms, friendly staff, breakfast, and amenities such as pool, jacuzzi and rooftop bar; several also noted available parking. Some guests reported disturbances — ocean noise at night, loud late café music, and bright exterior lighting — and a few mentioned minor room issues (broken blind, overloaded socket, lack of slippers), a safe charge, and mixed comments about the restaurant and bed comfort.
